scientific_question: Does local H1 identify anomalously soft disorder realizations at a fixed physical distance from the PBC reentrant exit, consistently across finite sizes?

physical_discovery.gate: mean right zero crossing finite and at least 95 percent of seed-bootstrap replicas finite for every L

L18_reinforcement.reason: The L18 mean curve crosses inside the old grid, but its positive ordered-side amplitude is not resolved sufficiently often under bootstrap; more independent samples, not a wider Gamma0 range, are required.
L18_reinforcement.guardrail: No H1 or spectral-gap data from the final holdout may be inspected before Gamma_exit(L) is frozen.

final_gate_result.diagnostic: The reinforcement cohort mean is non-positive throughout the frozen grid; the signed r=9 locator is not stable across independent disorder cohorts.

freeze_rule.L12_L14_L16: retain the physical estimates from the 100-seed discovery cohort
freeze_rule.L18: combine complete trajectories for seeds 1100-1299 on Gamma0=0.15...0.4 and apply the same right-zero-crossing estimator and 95 percent bootstrap gate
freeze_rule.on_pass: write the four numerical Gamma_exit(L) values and their source hashes into this specification before submitting any holdout spectra
freeze_rule.on_fail: do not launch the spectral holdout and report the physical locator as unresolved

primary_tests: geometric gap ratio H1-positive versus H1-negative after removing each (L,delta_Gamma0) stratum mean from log(gap01)
stratified AUC of continuous H1 maximum lifetime for predicting the bottom quartile of gap01 within each (L,delta_Gamma0) stratum

inference.low_gap_label: gap01 at or below the empirical 25th percentile inside each of the 12 frozen (L,delta_Gamma0) strata
inference.resampling_unit: the complete three-delta trajectory of one seed within one L
inference.permutation_rule: permute complete H1 trajectories among the 50 seeds separately within each L, preserving the dependence across delta_Gamma0
inference.cluster_bootstrap_rule: resample the 50 seed trajectories with replacement separately within each L and retain all three delta_Gamma0 observations
inference.multiple_testing: Holm correction across the two co-primary one-sided tests at family-wise alpha=0.05
secondary_tests: H1-by-L interaction in log(gap01) with (L,delta_Gamma0) fixed effects and seed-trajectory cluster bootstrap
adjustment for bulk_ms2, selected-window mean J, selected-window mean Gamma and cyclic window position
per-size and per-delta effect estimates with confidence intervals, reported without selecting a favorable subset

interpretation_rule.supports_main_claim: H1 enriches low-gap samples in the independent holdout after stratification and remains informative in the preregistered controls.
interpretation_rule.supports_limited_claim: The effect is present only at selected sizes or is absorbed by physical/disorder controls; report H1 as a finite-size geometric correlate.
interpretation_rule.negative_result: No reproducible out-of-sample low-gap enrichment; retain the h=0 paper and present reentrant topology as a documented limitation or move it to the supplement.
